description: Create a custom-image template (a reusable sandbox-image spec: base image + setup script + default resources). Build it into a bootable image later with tenki_build_template. NOTE: only a TYPED template (created with builder_spec, no legacy fields) can build a named, publishable image (image_name) that tenki_create_sandbox boots via its `image` arg.

base_image_id.description: Base image ID to build on top of.

builder_spec.description: Typed template spec, passed through as-is — e.g. {specVersion:'tenki.template.v1', base:{image:'sandbox'}, workdir:'/home/tenki', steps:[{run:{command:'...'}}], resources:{cpuCores,memoryMb,diskSizeGb}}. Mutually exclusive with base_image_id/setup_script/start_cmd/env_vars/cpu_cores/memory_mb/disk_size_gb/parent_* (the API rejects mixing). Required if the template's builds should publish an image (tenki_build_template image_name).

cpu_cores.description: Default vCPUs for sandboxes from this template (1-16).

env_vars.description: Environment variables as a key→value object.

parent_image.description: Derive this template from an existing built image reference.

parent_template_id.description: Derive this template from an existing template.

setup_script.description: Shell script run at build time to provision the image. Required for a from-scratch template (the API rejects a create without it unless you derive from a parent template/image).

start_cmd.description: Command run when a sandbox boots from this template.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to create in (defaults to the key's first workspace).

name: tenki_create_template
